name: Autodromo Internazionale del Mugello
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Grand Prix circuit, 15 turns (9 right, 6 left), 1,141 m main straight

start_finish.source: Start line: the full-width transverse white line at the front of the painted grid slots on the main straight, identified in the Regione Toscana 2023 orthophoto (the chequered finish line is about 33 m further on, under the bridge)

width.status: Measured from orthoimagery pavement colour; median 27 m and Gaussian 6 m smoothed; gaps interpolated

elevation.name: Regione Toscana DTM 10 m orografico
elevation.license: CC BY (Regione Toscana open data, dataset dem10mt)
elevation.attribution: Altimetria 10 metri, DTM orografico - fonte Regione Toscana - SIPT (da CTR 1:10.000)
elevation.bank: Zero: the 10 m DEM cannot resolve cross slope

imagery.name: Regione Toscana Ortofoto 2023 (OFC 2023, 20 cm)
imagery.attribution: Ortofoto 2023 - Fonte dei dati: Regione Toscana - Base Informativa Territoriale regionale, art. 55 della L.R. 65/2014

metadata.license: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL) for OSM derived geometry, separate from repository MIT source code
metadata.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; Ortofoto 2023 - Fonte dei dati: Regione Toscana - Base Informativa Territoriale regionale, art. 55 della L.R. 65/2014; Altimetria 10 metri, DTM orografico - fonte Regione Toscana - SIPT (da CTR 1:10.000)
limitations: Centerline is OSM geometry recentred on imaged pavement, not a survey
Kerb positions come from imagery colour; kerb height reuses Thunderhill's provisional profile
Grip, run-off surfaces, walls and barriers are not modelled
